meta.title: 面试问最大缺点，别再答「过于追求完美」
meta.title_en: Don't Say 'I'm a Perfectionist' When Asked About Weaknesses

scenes.context: 讲者指出「过于追求完美」的回答看似滴水不漏，实则让面试官反感。
sentences: 你最大的缺点是什么？你还是在说过于追求完美吗？
What's your biggest weakness? Are you still saying perfectionism?
最大的缺点：biggest weakness
看似滴水不漏，其实面试官挺反感的。
It sounds bulletproof, but interviewers find it off-putting.
滴水不漏：bulletproof
他会认为你在耍小聪明，不够真诚。
They read it as playing it smart — and not being genuine.
耍小聪明：play it smart
paraphrase: 完美主义回答=零信息量
避开的不是缺点，是套路
Avoid the cliché, not the honesty.
scenes.speak: What's your biggest weakness? Are you still saying perfectionism? It sounds bulletproof, but interviewers find it off-putting. They read it as playing it smart — and not being genuine.

scenes.context: 讲者点明面试官真正想看的是自我认知清晰度和控制力，并给出回答结构。
sentences: 面试官并不是真的好奇你的最大缺点到底是什么。
Interviewers aren't actually curious about your biggest flaw.
好奇：curious about
他想看看你对自己有没有一个很清晰的客观认识。
They want to see whether you have a clear, honest view of yourself.
客观认识：an objective self-view
典型的回答结构：讲缺点、讲场景、讲控制。
The classic structure: name the weakness, give a scenario, show how you manage it.
讲缺点/讲场景/讲控制：weakness, scenario, control
paraphrase: 这是自我认知的展示题
要的是控制力，不是完美
scenes.speak: Interviewers aren't actually curious about your biggest flaw. They want to see whether you have a clear, honest view of yourself. The classic structure: name the weakness, give a scenario, show how you manage it.

scenes.context: 讲者用「不太会拒绝人」做完整示范：缺点、场景、控制三步俱全。
sentences: 自己最大的缺点是不太会拒绝人。
My biggest weakness is that I have a hard time saying no.
不太会拒绝人：have a hard time saying no
一有问题我都亲力亲为，发现这牵扯了我不少精力。
I used to handle every issue myself — it was draining a lot of my energy.
亲力亲为：handle everything myself
客户再有问题，我会第一时间移交给售后的同学。
Now I hand issues to the support team right away, and I still keep an eye on progress.
第一时间移交：hand off right away
paraphrase: 真实缺点+具体场景+有效控制
Real weakness, concrete scenario, effective control.
Turn a flaw into a growth story.
scenes.speak: My biggest weakness is that I have a hard time saying no. I used to handle every issue myself — it was draining a lot of my energy. Now I hand issues to the support team right away, and I still keep an eye on progress.

practice: My biggest weakness is that I have a hard time saying no.
Early on, I handled every issue myself, which drained my energy.
Now I hand off issues right away and keep an eye on progress.
I have a clear, honest view of where I need to improve.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：My biggest weakness is pursuing perfection too much.
✓ 地道说法：I used to over-polish everything at the cost of speed.
过于追求完美要带出代价，不然没信息量。
✓ 地道说法：I have a hard time saying no.
不太会拒绝人→have a hard time saying no。
✕ 直译腔：I did everything by myself personally.
✓ 地道说法：I handled every issue myself.
✕ 直译腔：I transferred the customer to after-sales.
✓ 地道说法：I hand issues off to the support team.
移交→hand off to；售后→support team。
shifts: 正面回答：非岗位硬伤就如实说
footer_notes: ASR 校正：「面试官挺烦干的」校正为「面试官挺反感的」、「好好奇」校正为「好奇」；口播中重复的引导句已精简，运营岗示范案例保留原文结构。
